propositions: The runner raises on any base_url/api_key configuration despite documentation showing these fields as working for Ollama/LMStudio, creating a false contract between docs and implementation.
An openai builder must be registered conditionally (only when cfg.base_url is set) to inject the endpoint without making the openai SDK mandatory for bare openai:gpt-4o model strings.

The provider override must withdraw the native_structured_output capability (supports_json_schema_output=False) for opaque OpenAI-compatible endpoints while preserving other capabilities like supports_tools.
base_url is provider configuration not provider selection; REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER remains the sole selector and base_url must not hijack anthropic or other providers.
The openai SDK must be added to the dev extra only (not agents runtime extra) so tests can verify the endpoint recipe end-to-end without changing rebar's opt-in posture for users.

The profile override rides the Provider subclass (overriding model_profile staticmethod), not OpenAIChatModel(profile=...), because the S1 seam returns a Provider and pydantic-ai builds the model itself.
